fee_invoice_lines_paid.name: fee_invoice_lines_paid
fee_invoice_lines_paid.value: amount_paise > 0 and concession_paise >= 0 and credited_paise >= 0 and paid_paise >= 0 and concession_paise + credited_paise + paid_paise <= amount_paise

fee_invoices_open.name: fee_invoices_open
fee_invoices_open.where: status = 'issued' and paid_paise < gross_paise - concession_paise - credited_paise + late_paise

fee_invoices_paid.name: fee_invoices_paid
fee_invoices_paid.value: paid_paise >= 0 and paid_paise <= gross_paise - concession_paise - credited_paise + late_paise

fee_receipts_amount.name: fee_receipts_amount
fee_receipts_amount.value: amount_paise > 0 and advance_paise >= 0 and advance_paise <= amount_paise

notifications_group_open.name: notifications_group_open
notifications_group_open.where: "notifications"."group_key" is not null and "notifications"."read_at" is null and "notifications"."done_at" is null
